_comentario: Deliberate template-vs-reference wording differences (comparador.pontuar). PUBLIC REPO: patterns only, never a real name/CPF/value/address — validar_allowlist refuses digit runs and e-mails.
Patterns are Python regexes matched against the ACCENT-FREE LOWERCASE text (comparador._dobrar).

categoria: redacao | numero (remove padrao_ref from the reference and padrao_gerado from the render inside sections whose title key matches 'secao') | clausula_faltando (padrao_ref on the reference clause title key) | clausula_extra (padrao_gerado on the generated clause title key).
Only entries with aprovado_pelo_dono=true explain a difference; an unapproved entry is reported as pending and changes nothing.

Entry shape: {"id": "...", "categoria": "redacao", "secao": "^clausula:.*foro", "padrao_ref": "...", "padrao_gerado": "...", "motivo": "why the template deliberately differs", "aprovado_pelo_dono": false, "adicionado_em": "YYYY-MM-DD"}
